snippet.title: In a Bit of Tales - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey everyone! We're thrilled to announce that In a Bit of Tales is out now! This is our first commercial release, and we hope you love diving into our spooky anthology world!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3568300
itch.io: https://daybloomproject.itch.io/in-a-bit-of-tales

__________________________

If you spot any bugs or have tech suggestions, hop over to our Discord to let us know.

Discord: https://discord.gg/JjcBaxV84R
Twitter: https://x.com/daybloomproject
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gaming/daybloomproject

__________________________

Thanks so much for your support!

In a Bit of Tales is a one-of-a-kind horror anthology game featuring 7 spine-chilling stories, delivered in an omakase-style experience. Explore haunting dreams, mysterious cults, school curses, and more. Each tale is thoughtfully crafted to deliver a distinct and memorable horror experience.
